title: Rubico亚洲固收主管：新兴市场分化，印尼政策制定者开始应对挑战
speaker: Two Hot

segments.en: We're hoping that in the next few quarters, as we get a much clearer picture, that some of these levels will reach a level that they would be more stable and fixed income would be back in fashion. But it seems very hard given that everything is focused on the big textbooks right now.
segments.zh: 我们希望未来几个季度，随着形势更加明朗，这些收益率水平将趋于稳定，固收将重新受到青睐。但鉴于目前一切都聚焦于宏观大叙事，这似乎很难。

segments.en: That's true. You're seeing that dichotomy between what equities are looking at and what bond markets are pricing in. How do you look at EM right now? I know you have to be quite selective.
segments.zh: 确实如此。你看到了股市和债市定价之间的分歧。你现在如何看待新兴市场？我知道你必须非常有选择性。

segments.en: What are the clear winners and losers of this whole oil story? I look at a market like Indonesia where there is that commodity play, but the market seems to be focusing on fiscal concern, central bank independence. Have we heard enough from policymakers to reassure you?
segments.zh: 这轮油价故事中明确的赢家和输家是什么？我看印尼这样的市场，有商品属性，但市场似乎关注财政担忧、央行独立性。政策制定者是否已经说得足够多来安抚你？

segments.en: We were quite cautious of Indonesia earlier this year, but we're beginning to feel like the market consensus is moving, not quite there but nearly there, in actually dealing with some of these issues. I think policymakers are now beginning to address them.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候我们对印尼相当谨慎，但我们开始感觉到市场共识正在转变，虽然尚未完全到位，但已接近，实际上正在处理其中一些问题。我认为政策制定者现在开始应对这些挑战。
